subject.title: Session Routing Bugs: CLI routing to wrong session, WeChat ID inconsistency, and session deadlock from message flooding

question: Should this umbrella be split into separate core TUI routing, sessions_send channel routing, WeChat plugin/core routing, background-event isolation, and session-activity ordering items, and which owner boundary should own each remaining behavior?
rationale: Current source confirms unresolved core pieces, but the report crosses core Gateway/TUI behavior, external WeChat plugin ownership, sessions_send routing, and product-level activity semantics.

options.title: Split and route subproblems
options.body: Keep the existing narrower issues for sessions_send and meaningful activity, route subagent delivery overlap through the write-lock tracker, and create focused follow-ups for default TUI startup and live WeChat identity proof.

options.title: Keep umbrella as tracker
options.body: Leave this issue open as the single umbrella and block automation until maintainers can reproduce the WeChat and flood/deadlock paths live.

options.title: Close after narrow trackers exist
options.body: Close this umbrella only after every reported behavior is covered by a linked focused issue or merged PR with proof.

recommendation.title: Split and route subproblems
recommendation.body: Keep the existing narrower issues for sessions_send and meaningful activity, route subagent delivery overlap through the write-lock tracker, and create focused follow-ups for default TUI startup and live WeChat identity proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined history signal across TUI/session behavior, Sessions UX, and the WeChat docs boundary.
